loading: Shown while a turn's trace loads.
none: Shown for an old turn that has no trace.
label: Accessible name of the trace's section.
inferred: Tooltip on why the turn ended, when that was worked out after the fact.
rounds-of: How many model rounds the turn ran, and the most it may run ({{cap}}).
no-rounds: Shown when the trace has no model rounds.
dropped: Under the timeline: steps the trace didn't keep.
round.plain: A model round (one request to the AI model) and its number.
round.notes: The request that updated the chat's notes (its summary) before round {{round}}.
round.fallback: A round run on the shared model because the person's own was busy.
round.retry: A round sent again ({{retry}} counts the retries); the forms say why: rate limited, out of reach, or on the shared model.
round.first-output: How long until the model's first output ({{duration}}).
stop.stop: How a model round ended, lowercase. tool_calls: it called tools; length: it hit its output limit; content_filter: the provider's filter stopped it.
stop.tool_calls: How a model round ended, lowercase. tool_calls: it called tools; length: it hit its output limit; content_filter: the provider's filter stopped it.
stop.length: How a model round ended, lowercase. tool_calls: it called tools; length: it hit its output limit; content_filter: the provider's filter stopped it.
stop.content_filter: How a model round ended, lowercase. tool_calls: it called tools; length: it hit its output limit; content_filter: the provider's filter stopped it.
stop.error: How a model round ended, lowercase. tool_calls: it called tools; length: it hit its output limit; content_filter: the provider's filter stopped it.
stop.cancelled: How a model round ended, lowercase. tool_calls: it called tools; length: it hit its output limit; content_filter: the provider's filter stopped it.
outcome.ok: How a tool call ended, lowercase.
outcome.error: How a tool call ended, lowercase.
outcome.refused: How a tool call ended, lowercase.
outcome.timeout: How a tool call ended, lowercase.
image.screenshot: Name of an image a tool returned: a screenshot of a computer's screen.
image.image: Name of an image a tool returned.
compaction.title: A step: the conversation was cut down to fit the model's context window.
compaction.tokens: Tokens before and after, of the window's size; all compact counts (e.g. 182k).
compaction.cut: Tool results replaced by a short stub.
compaction.notes: Older turns folded into the chat's notes (its summary).
compaction.retry: Which retry of the fit this was.
compaction.facts: Remembered facts shown of those stored; the forms say how they were picked: by age, relevance, or a pointer.
notes.by-shared: A step: the chat's notes (its summary) were updated by the shared model; the -model forms add the model's name.
notes.by-chat: The same, by the chat's own model.
notes.turns: How many turns the notes covered.
notes.fallback.error: Why a plain summary was kept instead of the model's.
notes.fallback.empty: Why a plain summary was kept instead of the model's.
notes.fallback.cap: Why a plain summary was kept instead of the model's.
retry.rate_limited: A step: the model's provider turned the request away for its rate limit.
retry.unavailable: A step: the model couldn't be reached.
retry.sent: How long it waited before sending again ({{duration}}); the cut form: Stop or the time limit ended the wait.
fallback.title: Why: {{from}} and {{to}} are model names.
reactions: A step: the socio was told of reactions to its messages.
reaction: One reaction: its emoji, its name (lowercase, e.g. thumbs up) and how many.
wait.approval: A step: the turn waits for a person to approve a tool call.
wait.person: A step: the turn waits for the person to answer.
